newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms as funds kept in T-bills, for clients.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms as funds kept in T-bills, for clients.

text.p: The rouble firmed in active pre-holiday trading on Friday as banks sought funds for the Treasury bill market and the clients outside Moscow, dealers said.
Monday, March 10, is the Women's Day holiday in Russia.
roubles/dollar Mar 7 midday Mar 7 early Mar 6 close
"Roubles are not coming from the T-bill market as banks expect higher yields there in March," one dealer said.

Bank Menatep dealer Mikhail Zaretsky said banks sought roubles to transfer to their clients situated outside Moscow. They were also closing long dollar positions after active buying earlier this week, he added.
Trading was active as many dealers wanted to finish early ahead of the long weekend.
